tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Twilio credentials and API connectivity.

tools.name: get-account
tools.description: Get Twilio account information including friendly name, status, and current balance.

tools.name: list-phone-numbers
tools.description: List all phone numbers owned by the Twilio account with their capabilities (voice, SMS, MMS, fax).

tools.name: list-available-numbers
tools.description: Search for available phone numbers to purchase in a given country. Optionally filter by area code and capabilities. Use this before buy-phone-number to see options and pricing.

areaCode.description: Optional area code to filter by (e.g. "415" for San Francisco)

tools.name: buy-phone-number
tools.description: Purchase a phone number from Twilio. IMPORTANT: This spends real money from the account balance — always confirm with the user before buying. Use list-available-numbers first to find options.

phoneNumber.description: The exact E.164 phone number to purchase (from list-available-numbers)

friendlyName.description: Optional friendly name for the number

voiceUrl.description: Optional webhook URL for incoming voice calls

smsUrl.description: Optional webhook URL for incoming SMS

tools.name: send-sms
tools.description: Send an SMS message from a Twilio phone number. The fromNumber must be a number owned by the account with SMS capability. Costs apply per message sent.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +34600123456)

fromNumber.description: Twilio phone number to send from (E.164). Must have SMS capability.

tools.name: list-messages
tools.description: List SMS message history for the account. Can filter by sender, recipient, or date range.

dateSentAfter.description: Filter messages sent after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateSentBefore.description: Filter messages sent before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: list-calls
tools.description: List call history for the account. Can filter by caller, recipient, status, or date range.

status.description: Filter by call status: queued, ringing, in-progress, completed, busy, failed, no-answer, canceled

startTimeAfter.description: Filter calls started after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

startTimeBefore.description: Filter calls started before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: get-call
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific call, including duration, price, and recording URL if available.
